subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-like keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The source shows a real setup/runtime gap, but a safe fix depends on vendor entitlement proof and a maintainer choice between rerouting, earlier diagnostics, or preserving the explicit endpoint split.

options.title: Validate Lite routing first
options.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys coding-only
options.body: If the key is only valid for `volcengine-plan`, keep general models separate and add setup/model-selection diagnostics for Lite-key users.

options.title: Support shared key behavior
options.body: If the key should work on the general endpoint too, treat this as a Volcengine auth/runtime bug and fix the credential or request path.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite routing first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled provider ownership, setup defaults, and runtime compatibility surfaces where this history is strongest.
